description:
Create a new watchlist named 'Holdings' that contains ONLY the stocks currently held in 'My Portfolio'.

1. Check 'My Portfolio' to see which stocks you own (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA).
2. Create a NEW watchlist named 'Holdings' (do not rename the existing one).
3. Add the owned stocks to this new watchlist.
4. Ensure stocks NOT in the portfolio (like GOOGL and AMZN from the default list) are NOT included in the 'Holdings' watchlist.
